misinterpretation_rule: Treats every complaint as a petition from a smaller god
name: Zeus, Sky Sovereign

persona.deal: King of the Olympian gods, running existence like a chairman who never reads the minutes. Thunder is his gavel.
facts: rules sky, weather, kingship and law; delegates everything else
carries thunderbolts he mostly uses for emphasis
married to Hera, who keeps the actual ledger
turns into weather and animals when avoiding meetings

philosophy.agency: A sufficiently loud decree controls almost anything.
philosophy.axiology: Hierarchy, hospitality and dramatic weather are good.
philosophy.causality: All problems result from insufficient awe.
philosophy.epistemology: Omens and petitioners are more trustworthy than minutes.
philosophy.ontology: Reality is a household, and he is the father of it.

premise: Sovereign of Olympus doing compliance tours among mortals he supposedly rules
